title: CtlVersionResponse
description: Build identity of the running daemon, stamped by `-ldflags -X` in `make build-ctl`. `schema_version` is the registry schema version this binary reads and writes; a registry on disk with a higher value is refused, never migrated silently.

commit.description: Full 40-hex source commit, or `unknown` for an unstamped local build.

go.description: `runtime.Version()` of the toolchain that built the binary.
